LEAKAGE_MEASURED_upper_bound.probe: 4-hex-char UUID-prefix intersection of the T1 scene ids against the ACTUAL parity-corpus manifest (2376 episodes, key e438721ae894)
LEAKAGE_MEASURED_upper_bound.VERDICT: a prefix hit is NECESSARY but not sufficient for corpus membership, so this is a HARD UPPER BOUND: at most 2 of the 77 scored scenes can be in our training corpus. Observed hits (3/141, 2/77) are BELOW the chance expectation (5.02/2.74) and are fully consistent with ZERO true leakage. This REPLACES the base-rate ESTIMATE ('expected ~0.6 scenes') with a measurement.
LEAKAGE_MEASURED_upper_bound.caveat: the manifest stores only a 4-hex-char packed prefix, so exact identity cannot be resolved; only the UPPER BOUND is decisive.
LEAKAGE_MEASURED_upper_bound.note_on_the_hardcode: aggregate_t1_strategic.py:283 hardcodes our_build_n_clips = 2400; the canonical parity corpus is 2376. base rate 0.01562 vs 0.01547.

PER_EVENT_GATE_recovery.probe: replay the scene-level self-consistency refusal as a PER-EVENT gate over the 141 banked label files
PER_EVENT_GATE_recovery.REFUTES: the stream next_action claimed the per-event gate would 're-score the 38 events currently lost' and 'restore the leak-free subset's power to settle whether REF-C genuinely clears the best constant'. MEASURED: only 15 of the 38 survive (23 ARE the failing events). Leak-free gain is +7 events / +6 clusters (39 -> 45), a ~7% CI narrowing — it CANNOT move a bound sitting exactly at 0.0000. The claim generalised a SCENE-level count (24/31) into an EVENT-level recovery.
PER_EVENT_GATE_recovery.second_failure_mode: 11 of the 31 refused scenes fail with >150 deg error — a near-180 heading flip, a different (likely systematic) defect from the 36-55 deg cases. A per-event loosening mixes two failure modes and should separate them first.

STRICTER_FLOOR_control.probe: paired episode-cluster bootstrap, refc-base/navFOLLOW MINUS a map-informed UNIFORM-RANDOM draw over each event's admissible option CLASSES — a STRICTER floor than BEST_CONSTANT, which the STRATEGIC_SKILL_ADMISSIBLE gate does not use
STRICTER_FLOOR_control.why: UNIFORM_RANDOM_OVER_OPTION_CLASSES scores 0.5345 on this set and therefore BEATS BEST_CONSTANT (0.4397). The admissibility gate only requires clearing the constant, so it is the weaker of the two available floors.
STRICTER_FLOOR_control.SURVIVES: REF-C's route skill on the full 77 scenes clears the STRICTER map-informed floor too: mean +0.1897, separated on 8/8 seeds. This STRENGTHENS the stream's finding beyond what it tested.
